SLE.note: Document states nothing on rules or authority for AI harms.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Basic and Senior Secondary Education developed EDITH, an AI system for ministry officials' information-management tasks, by March 2026, and is preparing handover to its IT Department from pilot status.

systems.owner: Ministry of Basic and Senior Secondary Education

SLE.note: EDITH is an information tool for ministry officials, general administration, not a diagnosis, score or forecast in a sector system.

facts.fact: EDITH was developed by Sierra Leonean AI specialist Mohamed Alpha for the education ministry with a GBP 50,000 EdTech Hub support package, and is being prepared for handover, not yet released.
